plugins.name: Auto rip
plugins.description: Copies disc after disc to MKV with your MakeMKV installation: the main feature of a film or the episodes of a series, named and filed for Jellyfin, Plex, Emby and Kodi (Movies/Title (Year)/…, Shows/Series/Season 01/Series S01E01.mkv). When a disc is done it is ejected and the next one you insert is copied. Runs only after you press Start auto rip; otherwise Lumen plays discs as usual. Contains no decryption software. Looks up title and year on Wikidata (sends the disc's name; can be switched off). Needs Lumen 1.4 or newer and MakeMKV.
plugins.author: Lumen Plugins

plugins.name: Disc identification
plugins.description: Names the disc you insert. Audio CDs: album, artist, year, track names and cover from MusicBrainz. DVD, Blu-ray and Video CD: film title and year from the disc label via Wikidata. Sends the CD's disc ID or the disc label to these services. Needs Lumen 0.2.1 or newer.
plugins.author: Lumen Plugins

plugins.name: My AACS Plugin
plugins.description: Plays encrypted Blu-rays with MakeMKV (button Install MakeMKV downloads and installs it; its beta key is kept current, a key you bought is never touched) or with your own libaacs/libbdplus from the plugin's lib/ folder; drop your KEYDB.cfg onto the Lumen window to install the AACS keys. Also supplies DCP content keys from dcp-keys.txt. Contains no decryption software and no keys. Setup: button Instructions. The MakeMKV buttons need Lumen 1.4 or newer.
